[[Vinyor Tesh]]'s '''mother''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] researcher who worked on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]. During the [[Devastation of Manaan]], she was [[Death/Legends|killed]] along with her [[Vinyor Tesh's father|partner]] by the invading [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperials]]. Her young son was rescued by a visiting [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] called [[Laotah]], who brought him to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to be [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|temple]].<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vinyor Tesh's mother was mentioned in the Codex entry for Master Vinyor Tesh in the [[2019]] expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']] to the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' by the company [[BioWare]].<ref name="Codex" />
